title: Administrative Fee Waiver on Self-Pay Visit Package Refunds
content:
**Service-recovery schedule — refunds on the Self-Pay Visit Package.** The administrative fee on a refund is waived where the clinic itself cancelled two or more package-funded appointments (appointment cancellations in the patient's Appointment Series history recorded with the cancellation reason "clinic cancelled" and funded by the self-pay package), and is half of the tier's administrative fee where it cancelled exactly one. With no clinic cancellation this waiver does not apply.

**Fee by tier**

| Tier | Tier administrative fee | Exactly one clinic cancellation | Two or more clinic cancellations |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | $0.00 | $0.00 | waived: $0.00 |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | $25.00 | $12.50 | waived: $0.00 |
| Core 8-Visit Package | $25.00 | $12.50 | waived: $0.00 |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | $35.00 | $17.50 | waived: $0.00 |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | $35.00 | $17.50 | waived: $0.00 |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | $50.00 | $25.00 | waived: $0.00 |

**Reading notes**

- Only cancellations recorded with the reason "clinic cancelled" count; cancellations the patient made do not.
- Only appointments funded by the self-pay package count.
